purpose: Machine-readable inventory of player-facing capabilities that must not disappear silently during development.
policy: Every material PR declares preservation impact. Intentional retirement requires explicit product decision, replacement/migration evidence and updated tests.

capabilities.name: Browser game boots and core battle can start
Desktop selection, multi-selection, move and facing orders
Mobile select, multi-select/box alternative, move, facing, pan, pinch and formation controls
Accepted formation switching and formation cohesion remain available
Roads, road exits, bridges/chokepoints and legal route completion
Infantry, cavalry and artillery remain usable participants in the core battle
Existing deterministic combat, targeting and morale/routing behaviour does not disappear
Deterministic Test Lab/replay hooks required by regression coverage remain functional
Stable canvas/no blank frames and renderer fallback while an alternate renderer is experimental

mergeRequirements: all affected capabilities have passing mapped evidence on exact candidate head
no control or capability disappears from desktop/mobile by omission
replacement coverage lands before superseded coverage is removed
material post-merge main smoke is green before overlapping work starts
